findings.summary: Using `options?.encoding ?? ENCODING_TYPES.find(...)` skips the Accept-Encoding header check when the encoding option is set, so the body is compressed with an encoding the client may not support (e.g. gzip sent to a client that only accepts deflate or sends no header).
